description: BASELINE — unmodified code
Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05
Add LR warmup WARMUP_RATIO=0.05
Increase WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.6 and FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05
Replace ReLU² with SwiGLU gated activation in MLP
Set WINDOW_PATTERN=SSSL (3 sliding-window + 1 full attention)
Decrease MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03
Increase logit softcap from 15 to 30
Increase EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.8
Change WINDOW_PATTERN from SSSL to SSL (S,S,L,L pattern)
Decrease MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.02
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**16 to 2**15 for more optimizer steps
Halve WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1
Set ADAM_BETAS=(0.9, 0.95) — increase beta1 from 0.8 to 0.9
Set ASPECT_RATIO=96 for wider model (384 dim, 3 heads) at DEPTH=4
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**14 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 8 for more optimizer steps
Set EMBEDDING_LR=0.3 (lower from 0.6) for stability with wider 384-dim model
Halve WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.1 to 0.05
Set ASPECT_RATIO=128 for wider model (dim=512, 4 heads) at DEPTH=4
Set DEPTH=6 ASPECT_RATIO=64 — deeper model (6 layers) at same hidden dim (384)
Remove value embeddings entirely to save compute and get more training steps
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.7 for longer cosine decay phase
Set DEPTH=5 ASPECT_RATIO=76 — 5 layers at same 384 hidden dim (3 heads)
Set HEAD_DIM=64 to double attention heads from 3 to 6 at same 384 model dim
Replace linear LR warmdown with cosine schedule for smoother convergence
Tie wte and lm_head weights to share embedding/unembedding parameters
Increase MLP expansion from 4x to 6x for more MLP capacity
Reduce Muon ns_steps from 5 to 3 for faster optimizer steps
Add label_smoothing=0.1 to cross_entropy loss for regularization
Set DEPTH=3 ASPECT_RATIO=170 — shallow-wide model (3 layers, dim=512, 4 heads)
Add gradient clipping with max_norm=1.0 before optimizer.step()
Set WARMUP_RATIO=0.02 WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.65 for rebalanced LR schedule
Add z-loss regularization (1e-4) to penalize large logit magnitudes
Set UNEMBEDDING_LR=0.008 (double from 0.004) for faster lm_head learning
Enable value embeddings on ALL layers instead of alternating
Set MATRIX_LR=0.035 — bisect between 0.03 (best) and 0.04 (baseline)
Set EMBEDDING_LR=0.2 (down from 0.3) for lower embedding and value embedding LR
Set WEIGHT_DECAY=0.03 (down from 0.05) to continue weight decay reduction trend
Set ADAM_BETAS=(0.8, 0.99) — increase beta2 from 0.95 to 0.99 for more stable second moment estimates
Remove logit softcap entirely from forward pass
Set logit softcap=10 (down from 15) for tighter logit capping regularization
Set n_kv_head=1 for GQA with single shared KV head across 3 query heads
Increase Muon final momentum from 0.95 to 0.98 in get_muon_momentum warmup
Remove QK normalization from attention forward pass
Set logit softcap=8 (down from 10) for tighter capping regularization
